newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary mandates K&H Sec to manage pawnshop sale.
newsitem.headline: Hungary mandates K&H Sec to manage pawnshop sale.

text.p: Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt said on Thursday it had mandated K&H Brokerhaz Rt as lead manager for the sell-off of shares in pawnshop chain Bizomanyi Kereskedohaz es Zaloghitel Rt (BAV Rt).
The sell-off will include a private placement and a public offer, to be followed by a listing on the Budapest Stock Exchange, APV said in a statement.
APV announced a one-round public tender to manage the offering in late February.
Earlier this year APV said it planned to offer 73.97 percent of BAV Rt, which represents a nominal value of 1.63 billion forints.
APV said that of the share package on offer, 39.3 percent stake will be sold against cash while 13.5 percent will be placed with employees for compensation coupons privately.
The remaining 47.2 percent will be offered publicly for a mixture of cash and coupons.
Compensation coupons were awarded to victims of Hungary's fascist and communist regimes.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange the coupons traded at 670 forints, down 10, at 1009 GMT.
